analysis.primary_metric: mean end-of-minute total backlog over original H only
analysis.regime_handling: instant, one-minute and three-minute transport regimes analyzed separately; no pooled headline
analysis.weighting: average policy draws within each case; equal case weight and equal family counts within each regime
analysis.paired_unit: family and scenario seed; policy draws are not independent scenario observations
analysis.bootstrap: 2000 default paired percentile resamples of scenario seeds within each family; preserve policy pairing
analysis.effect_sign: positive mean_improvement/reduction_pct favors candidate; harms are positive excess backlog
analysis.harm_definition: max(candidate case mean backlog - baseline case mean backlog, 0); frequency uses tolerance 1e-6
analysis.static_risk_comparison: static_relative_harm profiles each policy against static; static_harm_comparisons contrasts those risk profiles using the same paired bootstrap, which differs from directly taking candidate-minus-comparator positive parts
analysis.cvar90_definition: average of the worst 10% empirical positive-part case harms, using fractional mass at boundary; zero means no positive case harm in this sample
analysis.drain_time: first zero-backlog time after original H, with already empty set to 0; censored at 32; report capped time and uncleared fraction together
analysis.censoring_scope: capped mean is a restricted follow-up measure, not an estimate of uncensored mean time to clearance
analysis.tail_definition: 32 minutes of zero new arrivals and constant last true original-horizon productivity; model assumption unknown in advance to policy
analysis.resource_minutes_lost: resources unavailable in transit during original H; follow-up losses reported separately; no monetary cost
analysis.zero_denominator: relative effects and ratio intervals are null for zero baseline; absolute harms remain meaningful
analysis.interval_scope: Monte Carlo variation within specified synthetic families conditional on fixed policy draws and queue mechanics; not model/deployment uncertainty
analysis.multiplicity: secondary/source/family intervals are descriptive and unadjusted; the frozen acceptance rule identifies predeclared decision comparisons
analysis.known_development: development cases were already observed in v0.2; only new 2000-2031 seeds form v0.3 validation
analysis.family_secondary_scope: per-family primary effects/harm intervals are provided; per-family secondary metrics retain point effects and paired counts
